name: encoding.xml
doc:
XML 1.0 for documents and configuration: a pull Reader (tokens with
namespaces resolved, tags checked), a Writer with indentation and
escaping, the dynamic Value tree and Parse<T>/Format<T> through
compile-time reflection with @xml(name:, attr:, text:, omitEmpty:, ns:,
skip:) and @serde. The tokenizer is C (runtime/src/std_xml.c). For
safety a DOCTYPE is reported as a Directive token and never interpreted:
no DTD is read and no entity other than the five predefined ones (and
character references) is expanded, so entity bombs are impossible.

items.doc: NewReader returns a reader over text (Strict is on).
items.summary: NewReader returns a reader over text (Strict is on).

items.doc: NewWriter returns a writer with no indentation.
items.summary: NewWriter returns a writer with no indentation.

items.name: Parse
items.doc:
Parses a document whose root element is a T (named as rootName says)
into a T: attribute fields from @xml(attr: true), the text from
@xml(text: true), other fields from child elements (slices from every
matching child). Unknown attributes and elements are ignored.
items.summary: Parses a document whose root element is a T (named as rootName says) into a T: attribute fields from @xml(attr: true), the text from @xml(text: true), other fields from child elements (slices from every matching child).

items.name: ParseValue
items.doc:
Parses a document into the tree of its root element. Comments and
processing instructions outside the root are dropped; with
keepSpace = false, character data that is only white space between
elements is dropped too.
items.summary: Parses a document into the tree of its root element.

items.name: Attr
items.doc: Attr is an attribute of an element.
items.summary: Attr is an attribute of an element.

items.name: Name
items.doc:
A name: Space is the namespace URI (or the unresolved prefix), Local
the local part, Prefix the prefix as written.
items.summary: A name: Space is the namespace URI (or the unresolved prefix), Local the local part, Prefix the prefix as written.

members.name: String
members.doc: prefix:local as written.
members.summary: prefix:local as written.

items.name: Reader
items.doc:
A pull parser: Next() returns the tokens of the text in order and Kind.EOF
at the end. Set Strict = false before the first Next to keep unknown
entities as text instead of failing.
items.summary: A pull parser: Next() returns the tokens of the text in order and Kind.EOF at the end.

members.name: Next
members.doc: Next returns the next token of the document; io.EOF at the end.
members.summary: Next returns the next token of the document; io.EOF at the end.

members.name: Depth
members.doc: The depth of open elements.
members.summary: The depth of open elements.

members.name: Attr
members.doc: The value of the attribute with local name `name` ("" if none).
members.summary: The value of the attribute with local name `name` ("" if none).

items.name: Value
items.doc:
A node of a document tree: an element (Kind StartElement) with its
attributes and children, or a CharData / Comment / ProcInst node.
items.summary: A node of a document tree: an element (Kind StartElement) with its attributes and children, or a CharData / Comment / ProcInst node.

members.doc: IsElement reports whether the value is an element.
members.summary: IsElement reports whether the value is an element.

items.name: Writer
items.doc:
Writes a document: Start/End elements, Text, Comment, ProcInst. With
Indent set, child elements go on their own lines; an element holding
only text stays on one line.
items.summary: Writes a document: Start/End elements, Text, Comment, ProcInst.

members.summary: The XML declaration <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>.
